exposure: PIH status (study group vs. control group)
outcome: Left ventricular function parameters (LVEDD, LVPWTd, IVSTd, LVEF, LVGLS, LVGCS, LVGAS, LVGRS)
cohort: 70 patients with diagnosed PIH and 70 healthy pregnant women
finding: Three-dimensional speckle tracking technology is more sensitive than traditional methods in detecting left ventricular strain and rotation in patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension.
mod_finding: The study group (PIH) had a higher rate of natural deliveries (72.86%) compared to the control group (31.43%), while the control group had a higher rate of cesarean sections (68.57%) compared to the study group (27.14%).
birth_weight: The study group had lower birth weight (2.71±0.41) compared to the control group (3.41±0.78).
